# dodopayments_meter_unarchive (Action)

Sends `POST /meters/{id}/unarchive`.

-> Actions need Terraform 1.14 or later.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Run "terraform apply -invoke=action.dodopayments_meter_unarchive.example" to send the request once.
action "dodopayments_meter_unarchive" "example" {
  config {
    id = "<id>"
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The ID of the meter.
